items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: No, I heard of his uncle. Matter of fact, it's a little deal I use now on Sister Kate when I was told his uncle uses it.

ctx.x: I think a few more things I think we can talk about to fill up some of this. We don't have to fill it all up necessarily. Did you ever know Sam's father? No, no. Old man Sam.
No, I heard of his uncle. Matter of fact, it's a little deal I use now on Sister Kate when I was told his uncle uses it.
